visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four animated characters sit at a table in a minimalist office. A man draws while three women work on laptops. The style is 2D monochrome animation. (2) A close-up reveals a grey rabbit character shouting angrily at the man, holding a slip of paper labeled as a resignation. (3) The rabbit points aggressively at a woman in a hooded animal suit, with chaotic work scenes flashing in the background. (4) The rabbit continues its rant, pointing at a crying girl with glasses while disparaging her artwork. (5) The scene returns to the office where the man and woman whisper about the rabbit's behavior. (6) The rabbit smiles smugly and displays a smartphone screen showing a fake lottery win of 500 million TWD. (7) A girl with mouse ears scans the rabbit's phone, which then displays a 'WARNING!!' alert over a matrix-like code background. (8) The girl warns the rabbit about the scam, and the visual style shifts to a bright blue promotional background. (9) A group of four characters holds phones displaying the 'Anti-Scam Guardian' logo. (10) Infographic screens detail AI technology and anti-phishing features of the app. (11) A protective blue dome forms around the rabbit and its phone to signify security. (12) A woman points to promotional graphics for iPhone 16 Pro Max and shopping vouchers. (13) The rabbit nervously tears up his resignation letter. (14) All characters stand together and laugh in a group shot with 'WWWWWW' text above them.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp impact sound triggers an aggressive male vocal rant with high arousal and fast speech. A low-volume, upbeat electronic BGM begins. (2) A 'ding' SFX marks a transition. The vocal delivery becomes more piercing as it addresses different characters. (3) A 'whoosh' leads to a short whisper sequence followed by high-valence smug laughter over a steady beat. (4) Digital UI chime sounds play as a lottery win is revealed. The BGM shifts to a driving promotional tempo. (5) Rapid warning beeps and scanning sounds dominate as a female voice explains anti-phishing technical features with clear articulation. (6) A rhythmic chanting of the brand name and features occurs over energetic synthesizer layers. (7) The sequence concludes with loud, high-arousal group laughter and a quick BGM fade.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video utilizes a comedic animation style to raise awareness about mobile lottery scams. It starts with a workplace drama where a character attempts to resign after being fooled by a fake prize, which transitions into an informative advertisement for Chunghwa Telecom's anti-scam app features and current promotions.
